summary: Prompt Copilot chat with 'Make sure I have ansible-dev-tools installed'; the assistant checks for ADT and, if missing, installs it with pip or pipx, then confirms in chat. Re-run 'check my Ansible environment' to verify.
questions: How do I install ansible-dev-tools with the AI assistant?
